children: Axe Compute entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement to sell its wholly owned subsidiary Helomics to DataMeds. The consideration includes 636,328 DataMeds shares, representing 19.99% of pre-closing outstanding shares, and a $1,363,672 convertible note at a $1.00 conversion price, with both securities subject to a 12-month lock-up. Closing occurred on September 11, 2026, concurrent with signing. Axe Compute will cover remaining base rent under two Helomics Pittsburgh leases, and agreed to a non-compete, completing its shift to a pure-play neocloud GPU-as-a-Service company.
